decision_contract.notice_check_allowed: Metadata supports acquiring the official text file only to verify its internal notice, edition, credits, and contributors. This is not a public-domain declaration or admission of prose.
decision_contract.hold_term_likely_active: Available author and publication evidence indicates that Japanese protection may still subsist. Do not acquire or inspect the ebook for this frame.
decision_contract.hold_identity_or_death_unverified: Neither a named-author death calculation nor a verified anonymous/pseudonymous publication-term calculation is supported well enough. Do not acquire or inspect the ebook for this frame.

japan_rules_applied: Terms run from January 1 of the year after death, publication, or creation as applicable.
The ordinary term changed from 50 to 70 years on 2018-12-30, without reviving an already expired term.
Anonymous or pseudonymous prose normally follows a publication-based term unless an author-identity exception applies.
A pre-1971 anonymous or pseudonymous work requires the old-law transition as well as later publication-term rules.
A term still running on 2018-12-29 because of wartime addition receives the extension; the published Allied-country maximum is 4,180 days.
method.pseudonym_rule: Use publication time only when evidence establishes anonymous or pseudonymous publication and no author-identity exception is established. An unexplained name without life dates is not assumed to be a pseudonym.
method.text_only_scope: Images, cover art, ornamental art, image-only credits, and illustration-specific captions or alt text are excluded; retained contributor-authored prose must be reviewed after acquisition.
method.content_blindness: Decisions use creator identity, publication evidence, and legal term only; title topic, sensitivity, lexical yield, MWE presence, and sense distribution do not affect a row.

incidental_search_exposure.description: Rights-oriented Web results exposed automated summaries, front matter, or source snippets for these already frozen rows. No ebook file was acquired and no target or MWE search was run; exposure cannot alter queue order or the first-unit rule.
